explanation.headline: FDA's records trace this shortage to a plant on our own labels

sentences.text: The FDA shortage list shows Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC haloperidol decanoate injection was posted as To Be Discontinued on 2026-01-09.
Our label for Cardinal Health product 55154955305 names Fresenius Kabi USA as the manufacturing plant.
Zydus Lifesciences Limited, another registered plant on our labels, received an OAI classification on 2019-05-03 with the classification known to FDA on 2019-11-14.
Zydus also received a Warning Letter on 2019-10-29 and a VAI inspection ending 2022-08-05.
Somerset Therapeutics has two ongoing Class II recalls for haloperidol decanoate, one initiated 2024-04-24 for foreign substance and another 2025-03-21 for lack of sterility assurance.
Corvale East has 15 days on hand, Corvale General 23 days, and Corvale Lakeside 16 days at current usage rates.

Q-5b2a2b.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%haloperidol%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%haloperidol%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-21aac6.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('e2eed126-cb82-42b1-9b48-9cbeb6873b50', '54502f78-7244-454a-9171-4e73127f1456') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-f0dbf5.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%haloperidol%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-7ac51e.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%haloperidol%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-6a315b.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%haloperidol%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-cb39b1.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3002984011') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-6ec47d.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3002984011') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-e24678.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3002984011') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('zydus lifesciences', 'fresenius kabi')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-21df60.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('zydus lifesciences', 'fresenius kabi', 'cardinal health 107', 'zydus', 'somerset therapeutics') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%haloperidol%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-f0f723.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('709477', '895756', '1088772') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-cf5f03.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('55154955305', '68382040901', '70069038405')

Q-e13065.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%haloperidol%'
